create_sandbox_mturk_worker: create a SandboxMTurkWorker instance from a MephistoDB and worker ID using the new static method
grant_sandbox_qualification: grant a crowd qualification to a sandbox MTurk worker by name with an optional value
revoke_sandbox_qualification: revoke a crowd qualification from a sandbox MTurk worker by name
get_sandbox_mturk_client: get a sandbox MTurk client for a given requester name using the internal _get_client method
register_sandbox_worker: register a new sandbox MTurk worker in the database with a sandbox suffixed worker ID
